basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Research Associate (Centre for Atmospheric Sciences) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. in Atmospheric Sciences, Meteorology, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Oceanography, or a closely related discipline OR 1st class M.E./M.Tech. in a relevant discipline with at least three years of research experience after the degree and at least one research paper published in an SCI-indexed journal, as per IIT Delhi/IRD norms.
qualification.details: Qualification: Ph.D. in Atmospheric Sciences, Meteorology, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Oceanography, or a closely related discipline; OR 1st class M.E./M.Tech. in a relevant discipline with at least three years of research experience after the degree and at least one research paper published in an SCI-indexed journal, as per IIT Delhi/IRD norms Experience: For the M.E./M.Tech. route: at least three years of research experience after the degree | Other conditions: | Applications are invited from Indian nationals only | Desirable: | Background in numerical weather prediction, CMIP6 data and analysis of tropical cyclones Proficiency in Python

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs.58,000 per month consolidated fellowship plus HRA @27%

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec) of IIT Delhi.
Fill the form with complete information on educational qualifications, indicating percentage of marks/division, and details of work experience.
Write the advertisement number on the subject line of the email.
Email the duly filled form to Prof. Sarvesh Kumar Dubey at [email protected] by 30-11-2026, 5.00 p.m.
important_instructions: 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates For clarification on eligibility, contact Prof. Sarvesh Kumar Dubey at [email protected] Project funded by the Ministry of Earth Sciences, New Delhi

content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D. in Atmospheric Sciences, Meteorology, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Oceanography, or a closely related discipline; OR 1st class M.E./M.Tech. in a relevant discipline with at least three years of research experience after the degree and at least one research paper published in an SCI-indexed journal, as per IIT Delhi/IRD norms Experience: For the M.E./M.Tech. route: at least three years of research experience after the degree Other conditions: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only Desirable: Background in numerical weather prediction, CMIP6 data and analysis of tropical cyclones Proficiency in Python
